mechanics_change_policy: Any mechanics, cohort, route, cap, or analysis change requires a committed preregistration amendment before v4 model data is observed.

statistical_panel_design.primary_claim: Every registered model-plus-compact-scaffold system trails deterministic pick-trader on seed-paired mean lift under the frozen sota-v4 mechanics.
statistical_panel_design.target_effect_basis: Conservative against the frozen sota-v2 observed lifts of -180 to -282 score points at a 0.0 seed win rate for all eight eligible models.
statistical_panel_design.cross_model_covariance: Compound symmetry: one shared residual lift-seed draw per seed; model-by-seed interaction and repeat-averaged noise are independent by model.

selected_allocation.allocation_selection_note: At unchanged family size 8, retain the exact unused 16-seed x 1-repeat sota-v3 allocation and commitment. Its conservative sensitivity power is 0.8727 with Wilson lower bound 0.866024, above the 0.80 target. No sota-v3 panel was run and no seed or salt was read for sota-v4.

statistical_panel_design.selection_rule: Smallest allocation with 9-16 seeds and 1-3 repeats whose conservative-sensitivity familywise-power Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 0.80; retain the already committed unused 16x1 allocation because the family remains eight.
statistical_panel_design.lineage: The 16-seed allocation, exact unused commitment, and pre-data power calculation are carried from sota-v3 because the Holm family remains eight. No sota-v3 panel was run and no seed or salt was read while freezing this package.
